description: Incremental progress toward a multi-step achievement, stored in the player's repository.

main.description: Tracks partial progress (e.g. `42 / 100`) toward an incremental `games.opengaming.achievement.definition` before it is unlocked. Update in place using a deterministic rkey per achievement to avoid repository churn.

game.description: Optional AT-URI of the game definition.

stepsNeeded.description: Optional snapshot of target `stepsNeeded` from the definition for single-read progress bar rendering.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when progress was last synced.

signatures.description: Optional inline publisher attestation (`games.opengaming.defs#inlineSignature`) over current progress.
